title: Empowering Youth through Responsible AI Governance
query: How has AI4IA discussed youth empowerment and responsible governance?
summary: The AI4IA conference archive highlights the importance of empowering youth to shape a responsible and inclusive AI ecosystem. Speakers emphasize the need for education, policy, and innovation to mitigate risks and ensure opportunities for young people in an AI-driven future. The discussion also touches on the role of governance and international cooperation in promoting ethical AI practices.
